plan.title: OtterFlop app shell and save foundation

narratives.Overview: Create the core static web app shell for OtterFlop, including routing/state transitions, touch-first layout, startup flow, and a versioned save-data model that supports nightly progress, unlock state, active otter roster, and future content additions.
narratives.Requirements: FR-1: The app launches into a child-friendly home flow on Amazon Fire tablet browsers. FR-2: The app stores otter kids, outfits, spins, bedtime completion state, and unlock history in local browser storage. FR-3: The app auto-saves after meaningful state changes without requiring manual save actions. FR-4: Existing save files remain usable when new unlockable content is added later. NFR-1: Initial load and main interactions must stay lightweight enough for a Fire tablet browser. NFR-2: Touch targets must be large and forgiving for a 4-year-old. NFR-3: The save schema must be versioned so upgrades are predictable.
narratives.Traces: Implements FR-1 through FR-4 and NFR-1 through NFR-3.
